objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-credentials-from-web-browsers-saved-in-temp-folder
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of files containing passwords, cookies, and saved login account information by the Braodo stealer malware in temporary folders. Braodo often collects these credentials from browsers and applications, storing them in temp directories before exfiltration. This detection focuses on monitoring for the creation of files with patterns or formats commonly associated with stolen credentials.
